_about: Brazil car list for CarWatch (same format as cars_config.json). NaPista and Mobiauto are read every day; OLX, Webmotors and Mercado Livre block automated reading, so 'links' (manual) and 'links_auto' (automatic, FB Civic and Yaris sedan) give one-tap searches to check by hand.
_automatics: Only generations with allow_auto keep automatic cars (FB Civic, Yaris sedan); every other car is manual only.
_split: split: a trim with its own chip and its own fair price (FA5 Civic Si apart from the regular FA5 Civic).
_fipe: fipe: how to find the FIPE reference price of each car: brand, a regex on the FIPE model name, whether the ad's version (LXR, XLS...) must appear in it, and how the brand marks automatics when it doesn't say Aut. Fetched within the free API limit and cached in data_br/fipe_cache.json.
